exercises.title: Hello, MentorSmith
exercises.prompt:
Write a program that prints exactly:
Hello, MentorSmith!
Java is compiled.

exercises.title: What does this print?
exercises.prompt: Predict the exact output. Pay attention to which method adds a newline.

exercises.title: Integer division surprise
exercises.prompt: Predict the output. Java performs integer division when both operands are int.

exercises.title: Changing a constant
exercises.prompt: This won't compile. Fix it so PI is 3.14159 and the program prints the area of a circle with radius 5.

exercises.title: Even or odd?
exercises.prompt: Predict what the ternary expression prints for n=7.

exercises.title: String comparison trap
exercises.prompt: This always prints 'not java' even when the input is 'java'. Fix it.

exercises.title: Sum 1 to N
exercises.prompt: Print the sum of integers from 1 to 10 inclusive. Expected output: 55

exercises.title: Off by one
exercises.prompt: This prints 1 2 3 4 5 6 but should print 1 2 3 4 5 only. Fix the loop.

exercises.title: Overloaded add
exercises.prompt: Predict the output. Java picks the method based on argument types.

exercises.title: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
exercises.prompt: This crashes. Fix it so it prints all 3 elements without crashing.

exercises.title: Useless toString
exercises.prompt: Printing a Point object shows something like Point@1a2b3c. Override toString to print Point(3, 4) instead.

exercises.title: ArrayList sum

exercises.title: Crash on bad input

exercises.title: Formatted printf output
exercises.prompt: Predict what this printf outputs. %.2f rounds to two decimal places.

exercises.title: Encapsulated user age
exercises.prompt: Write a static class User with private int age, a constructor User(int age), and a getter getAge(). Instantiate User(21) and print its age.

projects.title: Bank Account & Transaction Simulator
projects.purpose: Master Java OOP fundamentals, encapsulation, defensive validation, and Scanner interaction.

milestones.title: BankAccount encapsulation
milestones.requirements: Create BankAccount with private accountNumber, holderName, and balance. Reject negative deposits or withdrawals exceeding balance.
acceptance_criteria: Validates positive deposit amounts
Withdrawal checks sufficient funds and returns boolean success
Balance can only be mutated through deposit/withdraw methods
milestones.hint: Check if (amount <= 0) return false; before modifying balance.

milestones.title: Transaction history recording
milestones.requirements: Track an ArrayList of Transaction objects with timestamp, type (DEPOSIT/WITHDRAW), and resulting balance.
acceptance_criteria: Every successful mutation appends a Transaction record
Provides printStatement() method formatting transactions
Protects history from external modification
milestones.hint: Return new ArrayList<>(transactions) in getTransactions() to prevent outside mutations.

milestones.title: Interactive Console Menu
milestones.requirements: Provide a loop offering deposit, withdraw, check balance, and statement options via Scanner.
acceptance_criteria: Loop continues until exit option is chosen
Handles invalid menu choice with polite notice
Maintains account state throughout user session
milestones.hint: Use a switch (choice) block inside while (!exit).

extensions: Support multiple accounts with account lookup by ID
Add interest calculation for savings accounts
Persist account records to a local text file

projects.title: Enterprise Inventory Management System
projects.purpose: Harness Java Collections (HashMap, ArrayList), custom Exceptions, and file persistence.

milestones.title: Item entity and custom exceptions
milestones.requirements: Create Product item class and custom checked exceptions InsufficientStockException and DuplicateItemException.
acceptance_criteria: Exceptions inherit from Exception and carry descriptive messages
Product equals and hashCode methods use SKU string
Product fields are immutable or properly validated
milestones.hint: Override equals(Object o) and hashCode() using Objects.hash(sku).

milestones.title: Inventory catalog engine
milestones.requirements: Implement Inventory service using HashMap<String, Product> supporting restock, sell, and query operations.
acceptance_criteria: Throws InsufficientStockException when quantity requested exceeds stock
Lookup by SKU runs in O(1) average time complexity
Methods handle null inputs safely
milestones.hint: Use inventoryMap.get(sku) and check product.getQuantity() >= needed.

milestones.title: Robust file export and audit report
milestones.requirements: Write inventory status to report.csv and implement try-with-resources to safeguard against file leaks.
acceptance_criteria: Uses try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(...)) {} structure
Logs warnings for low-stock thresholds (< 5 units)
Re-reads catalog cleanly on startup
milestones.hint: Use BufferedReader and line.split(",") to parse existing catalog.

extensions: Filter catalog by price range or category using Java Streams
Sort products by stock quantity or name with Comparator
Add unit tests using JUnit assertThrows

projects.title: Thread-Safe In-Memory Cache & Server
projects.purpose: Master advanced Java concurrency: ReentrantLock / ConcurrentHashMap, TTL expiration, and TCP Sockets.

milestones.title: Thread-safe cache core with TTL
milestones.requirements: Implement ConcurrentCache<K, V> supporting put(key, value, ttlMillis) and get(key) with expiry eviction.
acceptance_criteria: Uses ConcurrentHashMap or ReadWriteLock for thread safety
Expired keys return null and are lazily or eagerly pruned
Supports stats tracking (hits, misses, evictions)
milestones.hint: Store a CacheEntry<V> object holding the value and expiration timestamp.

milestones.title: Background cleaner thread daemon
milestones.requirements: Start a scheduled executor service or background daemon thread that periodically purges expired keys.
acceptance_criteria: ScheduledExecutorService runs every N seconds
Clean shutdown hook terminates executor safely without hanging process
Does not throw ConcurrentModificationException during cleanup
milestones.hint: Use Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r -> { Thread t = new Thread(r); t.setDaemon(true); return t; }).

milestones.title: TCP client protocol handler
milestones.requirements: Bind ServerSocket on port 8080 and handle client commands: GET <key>, SET <key> <val> <ttl>, STATS.
acceptance_criteria: Spawns worker thread per client connection or uses thread pool
Parses command string and returns protocol response (OK / VALUE / NOT_FOUND)
Safely closes sockets on client disconnect
milestones.hint: Wrap clientSocket.getInputStream() in BufferedReader and output in PrintWriter.

extensions: Implement LRU eviction policy when capacity limit is reached
Support snapshot serialization to disk for persistence
Benchmark throughput with multi-threaded stress test
